statement: I treat AI as a tool, not a shortcut. I mostly use it to plan roadmaps, ask questions and polish documentation. In my personal projects I try to keep it out of the code, because I want to learn, I enjoy coding, and I want to fully understand and own what I ship. When it is simply useful, I use it, review every line before it ships, and disclose it in that project's README with one of the levels below.

levels.label: Consulting
levels.description: Questions, roadmaps, planning and docs. Nothing code related.

levels.label: Assisted
levels.description: AI wrote some files or features.

levels.label: Co-created
levels.description: A lot of the project was AI-assisted.

levels.label: Generated
levels.description: Fully built with AI. My only input was prompting.
